description: This file defines the interface for broadcasting backup and restore events within a system. It declares functions for starting and stopping the event producer, as well as broadcasting specific restore step events to listeners. The file includes necessary headers and uses include guards to prevent multiple inclusions.

methods.name: startBackupRestoreEventProducer
methods.description: Initializes the event producer for backup/restore events.

methods.name: stopBackupRestoreEventProducer
methods.description: Shuts down the event producer for backup/restore events.

methods.name: broadcastRestoreEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a restore step event to listeners, indicating the step number, name, and success status.
